hardware.fpga: KU5P FPGA-4IP, four independent gzip cores
hardware.cpu: 2 x Intel Xeon Gold 6336Y, 96 logical CPUs

method.verify: CRC32C over complete 10 GiB, also fresh-cache backend-only decode
method.writeback: raw cache, local fsync; separate wait to backend drain
method.ab_order: single then quad, repeated three times, same binary with original reset
method.final_order: three quad runs after state-based reset; separate measurement window
method.memory_window: whole group device opens/closes and compression; outputs preallocated RAM; full gzip decode and byte comparison outside compression timer
method.memory_inputs: distinct 8-byte per-core/per-round tags; 16 chunks per core per round

validation.http_note: short functional test, not a sustained throughput benchmark

recovery.sequence: SIGSTOP worker, write+local-fsync 10GiB raw, SIGKILL mount and worker, remount with four cores, sync to backend, hot and backend-only full CRC

compactfs local updated SDK CGO_ENABLED=0 tests and vet
